From: dr.elena.vasquez@meridian-general.org
To: safety@clinicverse.com
Subject: URGENT: Patient Fall Incident Report - Ward 3B
Date: 2025-08-12T09:15:00Z

Patient Incident Report

Report ID: IR-2025-0847
Date of Incident: 2025-08-11
Time: 14:32

Patient Information:
Name: Marcus J. Thornton
DOB: 03/15/1958
MRN: MRN-44721
Ward: 3B - Medical Surgical

Incident Details:
Patient was found on the floor beside the bed at approximately 14:32.
Patient had been prescribed Metoprolol 50mg twice daily and Diazepam 5mg at bedtime.
Nurse on duty: Angela Torres, RN
Post-fall assessment completed. No visible injuries. Vital signs stable.
Patient was assisted back to bed. Neurological observations initiated.

Product/Device Involved:
Bed rails were in the UP position at time of incident.
Call bell was within reach but not activated.

Actions Taken:
1. Attending physician notified: Dr. R. Vasquez
2. Fall risk reassessment completed (score increased to High)
3. 1:1 observation initiated
4. Family notified - contact: (555) 012-7890
5. Incident report filed with Risk Management

Outcome: Patient recovered without injury. Monitoring continues.

Reported by: Angela Torres, RN
Witness: CNA David Kim

extracted_facts.value: Patient recovered without injury. Monitoring continues.
